honest_wall: Finite range only: 1093 and 3511 are the only Wieferich primes below 1000000; whether infinitely many exist stays OPEN. No others are known below 6.7x10^15 (Dorais-Klyve 2011, since extended past 1.45x10^17, OEIS A001220).
references: Wieferich 1909 (link to Fermat's Last Theorem, first case)
